decks.notes: This Boros Aggro deck focuses on fast, aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The use of Jegantha as a companion allows for additional mana ramping. Cards like Amped Raptor, Ajani, Nacatl Pariah, and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury provide a strong attacking force, while Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Discharge offer direct damage. The inclusion of Blood Moon disrupts opponents' mana bases, and cards like The One Ring and Arena of Glory provide additional boosts to creatures. Overall, the deck aims to quickly take control of the board and win through aggressive play.

This deck focuses on utilizing The One Ring as a powerful control tool to manipulate the game to your advantage. With a mix of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage engines like Snapcaster Mage and Teferi, Time Raveler, you can disrupt your opponent's strategy while building towards your own win condition. Additionally, the deck includes versatile lands and a variety of utility cards to adapt to different situations. The ultimate goal is to outlast and outsmart your opponent until you can secure a victory with The One Ring.

This deck focuses on combining the cards Birthing Ritual, Unearth, and Flare of Malice to repeatedly bring back and sacrifice creatures to create an endless loop of death triggers with cards like Bloodghast and Marionette Apprentice. By using cards like Stitcher's Supplier and Gravecrawler to fill the graveyard, the deck can quickly assemble its combo pieces for a game-winning finish. Additionally, the inclusion of Zulaport Cutthroat and Chatterfang, Squirrel General helps to drain the opponent's life points while creating additional tokens for added value.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of countering spells, removing threats from the board, and manipulating the opponent's hand and deck. It also includes cards that allow for card draw and advantage, as well as a powerful win condition in The One Ring. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while building towards a strong board state and eventually overwhelming them with powerful spells and abilities.

The deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a mix of red and white creatures and spells, and uses Jegantha as a companion. The deck includes powerful cards like Lightning Bolt, Ragavan, and Phlage to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Blood Moon and Static Prison to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with early aggression and efficient removal spells to secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful burn spells. It also utilizes the companion Jegantha for additional mana ramping. The key strategy is to maintain a steady stream of threats while controlling the board with removal spells and disruptive enchantments like Blood Moon and Static Prison. The deck aims to quickly close out the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize, utilizing cards like Lightning Bolt and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah to finish off any remaining health.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on fast, aggressive play with a mix of burn spells and creature threats. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Blood Moon and Static Prison to slow down opponents, while Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Guide of Souls provide additional support for creatures. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion adds an extra layer of versatility to the deck. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to apply early pressure and maintain control of the battlefield to secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on assembling the Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle combo to deal massive amounts of damage to the opponent. It includes cards like Wrenn and Six and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove to ensure consistent land drops and trigger Valakut multiple times per turn. Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding provide protection and control elements, while Malevolent Rumble and Wrath of the Skies serve as board wipes. The deck aims to control the board early on while setting up the combo for a devastating finish.

This deck focuses on using alternate win conditions through powerful combos without relying on traditional land cards. By utilizing a variety of counter spells, card draw, and tutoring abilities, the deck aims to assemble the necessary pieces to combo off and win the game quickly. The deck includes cards like Goblin Charbelcher and Lotus Bloom to generate mana or deal damage, as well as creatures like Fallaji Archaeologist and Thundertrap Trainer to further facilitate the combo. With careful planning and timing, the deck can overwhelm opponents with unexpected and devastating combos.

The deck focuses on fast and aggressive plays using Eldrazi creatures and artifacts to disrupt the opponent's game plan. By utilizing cards like Chalice of the Void to lock down spells, Eldrazi Temple to ramp up mana, and powerful creatures like Thought-Knot Seer and Reality Smasher, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly. With a mix of disruptive elements and powerful threats, the deck seeks to control the game early on and secure a victory before the opponent can mount a defense.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo using cards that generate mana without needing lands. By utilizing cards like Lotus Bloom and Pentad Prism, the deck can quickly ramp up its mana production to cast powerful spells like Sea Gate Restoration and Whir of Invention. The key concept is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and unexpected win condition, often involving cards like Goblin Charbelcher or Rush of Inspiration to secure victory before the opponent has a chance to respond. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent while maintaining a strong board presence to ensure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize the combo of Vizier of Tumbling Sands, Lotus Field, and Underworld Breach to generate infinite mana and cast spells from the graveyard. By continuously casting Twiddle and Hidden Strings to untap Lotus Field, players can generate a large amount of mana, which can then be used to cast spells like Wish and Consign to Memory multiple times in a single turn. Boseiju, Who Endures can help protect key combo pieces from counterspells, while Otawara, Soaring City provides additional utility and consistency to the deck.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. By utilizing a mix of creatures with powerful abilities like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Tribal Flames along with efficient removal like Lightning Bolt and Stubborn Denial, the deck aims to maintain a fast pace and put pressure on the opponent. Leyline of the Guildpact helps to maximize the effectiveness of the multicolored creatures in the deck, while cards like Scion of Draco and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury provide additional threats to close out the game.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with efficient creatures and burn spells. The deck aims to maintain a fast pace and keep the pressure on the opponent, using cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Lightning Bolt to deal damage quickly. The inclusion of Aether Hub and Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional flexibility and mana ramp. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Goblin Bombardment and Static Prison to control the game and prevent the opponent from stabilizing.

The main concept of this deck is to use a combination of cards like Thassa's Oracle, Angel's Grace, and Phyrexian Unlife to protect yourself while setting up a win condition using Spoils of the Vault to search for your combo pieces. Pact of Negation and Flare of Denial help to protect your spells while Sleight of Hand and Preordain help with card selection. Thundertrap Trainer and The One Ring provide additional win conditions. The land base is designed to support the color requirements of the deck while also including utility lands like Otawara, Soaring City and Undercity Sewers.

The main concept of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and hand disruption. By efficiently removing threats, denying the opponent key spells, and drawing cards with cards like Murktide Regent and Archmage's Charm, the deck aims to establish and maintain control of the game until it can win with its win conditions. The inclusion of cards like Psychic Frog and Undercity Sewers also provide additional disruption and removal options to keep the opponent on the back foot.
